 Shri Justice B. P. Routray
 Order
Heard Mr. Nanda, learned counsel for the Appellant - Petitioner and Mr. Tripathy, learned Addl.P.P. for State - Respondent.

2. The Appellant namely, Manoj Bhue who is convicted for commission of offences under Section 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code and sentenced to undergo R.I. for twenty years along with fine by learned 1st Additional Sessions Judge-cum-P.O., Children's Court, Balangir in his judgment dated 28th February 2025 has prayed to release him on bail pending appeal.

entities.text: 1st Additional Sessions Judge-cum-P.O., Children's Court, Balangir
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted that the Appellant is an adolescent boy and has been inside custody since 28th February 2025 upon conviction and was detained prior to that for the period from 14th December 2021 to 4th March 2022.
It is also submitted that the Appellant was not initially named in the FIR and the medical evidence does not support the statement of the victim.
Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack 4.

Upon hearing both parties and considering the evidence of the witnesses including the victim (P.W.16) as well as the circumstances of the case including the medical evidence, it is directed to Manoj Bhue vs State Of Odisha on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173878440/
1 release the Appellant-Petitioner on bail pending appeal on such terms and conditions to be fixed by the learned 1st Additional Sessions Judge- cum-P.O., Children's Court, Balangir in connection with Sessions Case No. 02 of 2022 arising out of Loisingha P.S. Case No.375 of 2021.

8. An urgent certified copy of this order shall be issued on proper application.

9. List the appeal for hearing on first week of December 2025.
